decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI from GPIO26 to GPIO47 does not alter the LED power, GPIO3 rail control, or logic-level shifting requirements.
The standalone USB power source, activation condition, capacity, and powered scope are independent of the SPI MOSI assignment.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not change the power-source OR-ing topology or source-selection behavior.
The source decision concerns SPI MOSI, not the unresolved suitability or placement of I2C series resistors.
The charge-status output remains assigned to GPIO13 and is unaffected by the SPI MOSI change.
The switched boost supply remains controlled by GPIO5; adopting GPIO47 for SPI MOSI does not change that assignment or the powered loads.
The interboard connectors do not carry SPI MOSI, so changing its ESP32 GPIO assignment does not alter their pinouts or matching-order policy.
The source decision changes SPI MOSI only and does not alter I2C speed, pull-ups, cable length, or series-resistor policy.
The AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology is electrically and semantically independent of the main-board SPI MOSI GPIO assignment.
The decision does not change the LED board's count, type, or layout requirements.
The battery connector's placement, format, pin functions, and unresolved pinout are unrelated to SPI MOSI.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not affect battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
